source_note: Land polygons. Sea is derived by splitting the extent with the OSM coastline and classifying faces from open-water seeds, because OSM does not tag the open ocean and a dissolve of natural=water alone would render everything west of Fremantle as land. River and lake polygons above 5000 m2 are subtracted. Simplified with Douglas-Peucker at 10 m in EPSG:7850. ORIENTATION ONLY, NOT FOR NAVIGATION: banks are crowd-sourced, nothing here describes sandbanks, and Point Walter spit is submerged at higher tides and mapped inconsistently.
